VIGILANCE PROFILE OF OFFICERS FOR WHOM VIGILANCE COMMENTS /
CELARANCE BEING SOUGHT

#/texts/1.label: paragraph
#/texts/1.full_gt_text: (To be furnished and signed by the CVO or HOD)

#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
8. Whether the officer has been placed :
on the "Agreed List" or "List of
Officers of Doubtful Integrity".
(If yes, details to be given)
9. Whether any allegation of misconduct :
involving vigilance angle was
examined against the officer during
the last 10 years and if so with
what result (*)
10. Whether any punishment was awarded to :
the officer during the last 10 years and
if so, the date of imposition and details
of the penalty (*)
11. Is any disciplinary / criminal proceedings :
or charge sheet pending against the officers,
as on date. [If so, details to be furnished –
including reference no., if any,
of the Commission]
12. Is any action contemplated against the :
officer as on date [If so, details to be
furnished (*)
13. Whether any complaint with :
vigilance angle is pending against
the officer [If so, details
to be furnished].

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: (*) If vigilance clearance had been obtained from the Commission in the past, the information may be provided for the period thereafter.
